title: Ants keep livestock
topic: Ants farm aphids for honeydew, defend them, move them between plants, and stop them leaving
voice_script: Ants keep livestock, and the livestock is aphids. The ants stroke them with their antennae until the aphids release a drop of sugar. In return the ants drive off ladybugs and carry the herd to fresher stems. Some species go further. They chew the wings off aphids that try to leave, and their footprints carry a chemical that keeps the rest sluggish and close. It is not a partnership. The aphids are being farmed, and they cannot go.
